special_processing.description: 5. start_from (初回契約始期 -> そのまま / 契約中(他社) -> 2026/01/01)
special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE (contract AS T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS I ON T.ID = ('C1_' & I.ID)) SET T.start_from = I.[初回契約始期] WHERE T.sheet = '契約' AND I.[初回契約始期] IS NOT NULL ;
UPDATE (contract AS T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS I ON T.ID = ('C1_' & I.ID)) SET T.start_from = #2026/01/01# WHERE T.sheet = '契約' AND I.[契約状況] = '契約中(他社)' ;

special_processing.description: TODO: 紐づけ元のフィールド名が未定義のため、[SOURCE_FIELD]を適切な列名に書き換えてください
special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE (contract As T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS T1 ON T.[ID] = ('C1_' & T1.[ID])) INNER JOIN [物件管理情報一覧] AS T2 ON T2.[物件No] = T1.[物件No] SET T.sublease = '1' WHERE T2.[管理形態] = '一括借上' AND T.sheet = '契約' ;

special_processing.description: TODO: 紐づけ元のフィールド名が未定義のため、[SOURCE_FIELD]を適切な列名に書き換えてください
special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE (contract As T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS T1 ON T.[ID] = ('C1_' & T1.[ID])) INNER JOIN [契約情報一覧] AS T3 ON T3.[物件No] = T1.[物件No] AND T3.[部 屋] = T1.[部屋No] SET T.legacy_contractor_id = IIf(T.[legacy_resident_id] <> T3.[契約者No], T3.[契約者No], NULL) WHERE T.sheet = '契約' ;

special_processing.description: JOIN条件の「legacy_resident_id」に対応する解約情報一覧側のフィールドも [JOIN_FIELD] を書き換えてください。
special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE (contract AS T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS T1 ON T.[ID] = ('C1_' & T1.[ID])) INNER JOIN [解約情報一覧] AS T4 ON T4.[物件No] = T1.[物件No] AND T4.[部 屋] = T1.[部屋No] AND T4.[契約者No] = T.[legacy_resident_id] SET T.end_date = T4.[受付・立会情報 解約日] WHERE T.sheet = '契約' ;

special_processing.description: 9. legacy_id の生成 (legacy_contractor_idがブランクではない場合)
special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE (contract AS T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS T1 ON T.[ID] = ('C1_' & T1.[ID])) SET T.legacy_id = IIf(Nz(T.legacy_contractor_id,'') <> '', T1.[物件No] & '-' & T1.[部屋No] & '-' & T.legacy_contractor_id, T1.[物件No] & '-' & T1.[部屋No] & '-' & T.legacy_resident_id) WHERE T.sheet = '契約' ;

UPDATE (contract AS T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS T1 ON T.[ID] = ('C1_' & T1.[ID])) SET T.electricity_contact_name = T1.[電気業者名], T.electricity_contact_tel = T1.[電気業者TEL1] WHERE T1.[電気業者名] NOT LIKE '*電気 家主一括契約*' AND T1.[電気業者名] NOT LIKE '*水道 家主一括契約*' ;

UPDATE (contract AS T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS T1 ON T.[ID] = ('C1_' & T1.[ID])) SET T.drink_water_contact_name = T1.[上水道業者名], T.drink_water_contact_tel = T1.[上水道業者TEL1] WHERE T1.[上水道業者名] NOT LIKE '*水道 家主一括契約*' ;

UPDATE (((contract AS T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS I ON T.ID = ('C1_' & I.ID)) INNER JOIN [契約情報一覧] AS K ON I.[物件No] = K.[物件No] AND I.[部屋No] = K.[部 屋] AND I.[初回契約始期] = K.[契約始期]) INNER JOIN [契約者情報] AS C ON K.[契約者No] = C.[契約者No]) SET T.kind_id = IIF(C.[契約者区分] = '法人', '20', IIF(C.[契約者区分] = '個人', '10', T.kind_id)) WHERE T.sheet = '契約' ;
UPDATE (contract AS T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS I ON T.ID = ('C1_' & I.ID)) SET T.kind_id = '10' WHERE T.sheet = '契約' AND I.[契約状況] = '契約中(他社)';

special_processing.description: 14. end_until (契約終期 -> そのまま / 契約中(他社) -> 9999/12/31)
special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE (contract AS T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS I ON T.ID = ('C1_' & I.ID)) SET T.end_until = I.[契約終期] WHERE T.sheet = '契約' AND I.[契約終期] IS NOT NULL ;
UPDATE (contract AS T INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS I ON T.ID = ('C1_' & I.ID)) SET T.end_until = #9999/12/31# WHERE T.sheet = '契約' AND I.[契約状況] = '契約中(他社)' ;

normal_processing.legacy_id: T.[物件No] & '-' & T.[部屋No] & '-' & T.[契約者No]

output_conditions.description: 既存の入居状況と紐づくものを除外(物件No/部屋No/契約者NoでFLG=1更新)
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE [新規契約更新一覧] AS T SET T.FLG = '1' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM [入居状況一覧] AS T1 WHERE T1.[物件No] = T.[物件No] AND T1.[部屋No] = T.[部屋No] AND IIF(T1.[契約者3入居有無] = '入居有り', T1.[契約者3No], IIF(T1.[契約者2入居有無] = '入居有り', T1.[契約者2No], IIF(T1.[契約者1入居有無] = '入居有り', T1.[契約者1No], NULL))) = IIF(T.[契約者3入居有無] = '入居有り', T.[契約者3No], IIF(T.[契約者2入居有無] = '入居有り', T.[契約者2No], IIF(T.[契約者1入居有無] = '入居有り', T.[契約者1No], NULL))) ) ;

output_conditions.description: 重複削除のため(FLG=2更新)
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE [新規契約更新一覧] SET FLG = '2' WHERE ID IN ( SELECT MIN(ID) FROM [新規契約更新一覧] WHERE FLG = '1' GROUP BY IIF([契約者3入居有無] = '入居有り', [契約者3No], IIF([契約者2入居有無] = '入居有り', [契約者2No], IIF([契約者1入居有無] = '入居有り', [契約者1No], NULL))) );

output_conditions.description: set_charge (set charge = 0)
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE [契約情報一覧] AS S INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS T ON T.[物件No] = S.[物件No] AND T.[部屋No] = S.[部 屋] AND T.[初回契約始期] = S.[契約始期] SET S.[FLG] = '1';

output_conditions.description: Execute SQL
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE Contract  AS S SET S.charge_rent = '0', S.charge_management = '0', S.charge_parking = '0', S.charge_additional = '0', S.charge_deposit = '0', S.charge_gratuity = '0' WHERE S.[ID] LIKE 'C1_%' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM [契約情報一覧] AS T WHERE T.[契約者No] = S.[legacy_resident_id] AND T.[FLG] = '1' );

special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE (Contract AS T INNER JOIN [新規契約更新一覧] AS T1 ON ('C2_' & T1.ID) = T.ID) SET T.legacy_resident_id = IIF(T1.[契約者3入居有無] = '入居有り', T1.[契約者3No], IIF(T1.[契約者2入居有無] = '入居有り', T1.[契約者2No], IIF(T1.[契約者1入居有無] = '入居有り', T1.[契約者1No], NULL))) ;

output_conditions.description: GMO入居状況一覧.csvと契約情報一覧.csvのマージ
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE [契約情報一覧] AS S INNER JOIN [入居状況一覧] AS T ON S.[物件No] = T.[物件No] AND S.[部 屋] = T.[部屋No] AND S.[契約始期] = T.[初回契約始期] SET S.FLG = '1' ;

output_conditions.description: 契約情報一覧.csvと契約者情報.csvのマージ
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE [契約者情報] AS S INNER JOIN [契約情報一覧] AS T ON S.[契約者No] = T.[契約者No] SET S.FLG = '1' ;

output_conditions.description: 出力条件 契約情報一覧
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE [契約者情報] SET FLG = '0' WHERE ID NOT IN ( SELECT MIN(ID) FROM [契約者情報] GROUP BY [契約者No] ) ;

output_conditions.description: 契約者情報.csvのマージ (email, tel_mobile, kind_id の取得)
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE (contractor AS T INNER JOIN [契約情報一覧] AS T1 ON T.ID = ('CR_' & T1.ID)) INNER JOIN [契約者情報] AS T2 ON T1.[契約者No] = T2.[契約者No] SET T.kind_id = T2.[契約者区分], T.email = T2.[優先メール], T.tel_mobile = T2.[携帯1] WHERE T2.[FLG] = '1' ;

special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE Contractor  AS T INNER JOIN [T_MAP_kind_id_Contractor] AS M ON T.kind_id = M.[個人法人区分] SET T.kind_id = M.[kind_id] WHERE T.sheet = '契約者';

normal_processing.name: T.[部屋No]
normal_processing.address_1: Nz(T.[町地域名],'') & Nz(T.[丁番地名],'') & Nz(T.[住所その他],'')

output_conditions.description: 不要行を削除するため(FLG=1更新) - 重複削除 (データ順で１番最初のデータを出力対象とする)
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE [入居状況一覧] SET FLG = '1' WHERE ID NOT IN ( SELECT MIN(ID) FROM [入居状況一覧] GROUP BY [物件No], [部屋No] ) ;

special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE Property  AS T INNER JOIN [T_MAP_kind_id_Property] AS M ON T.kind_id = M.[種別] SET T.kind_id = M.[ID] WHERE T.sheet = '部屋' ;

output_conditions.description: 既存の部屋と紐づくものを除外 (入居状況一覧に存在する 物件No + 部屋No を除外)
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE [新規契約更新一覧] As T SET T.FLG = '1' WHERE T.[物件No] & '-' & T.[部屋No] IN ( SELECT T1.[物件No] & '-' & T1.[部屋No] FROM [入居状況一覧] AS T1 WHERE T1.[物件No] IS NOT NULL ) ;

output_conditions.description: 不要行を削除するため(FLG=1更新) - 重複削除 (データ順で１番最初のデータ1件のみを採用)
output_conditions.sql_query: UPDATE [新規契約更新一覧] SET FLG = '1' WHERE FLG = '0' AND ID NOT IN ( SELECT MIN(ID) FROM [新規契約更新一覧] GROUP BY [物件No], [部屋No] ) ;

special_processing.description: kind_id: "P"もしくは"駐"が含まれていない場合
special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE Property  As T INNER JOIN [新規契約更新一覧] AS T1 ON T.ID = ('P2_' & T1.ID) SET T.kind_id = '10' WHERE T1.[部屋No] NOT LIKE '*P*' AND T1.[部屋No] NOT LIKE '*駐*' ;

special_processing.description: kind_id: "P"もしくは"駐"が含まれる場合
special_processing.sql_query: UPDATE Property  As T INNER JOIN [新規契約更新一覧] AS T1 ON T.ID = ('P2_' & T1.ID) SET T.kind_id = '20' WHERE T1.[部屋No] LIKE '*P*' OR T1.[部屋No] LIKE '*駐*' ;
